notes: The certificate section prints no outcomes of its own; the outcomes recorded are the single list printed under the COMPUTER INFORMATION SYSTEMS program heading ('Upon successful completion of the degree or certificate program'), which the certificate appears to share. That list repeats the first three outcomes with labels; all six are copied as printed.

The group choice is printed as 'Select one of the following groups of courses: 3-4 units', with Programming 3-4 units and User Support 3 units. The Programming block is read as one course and User Support as 3 units (one course).

Under that reading the core (16) plus the group (3-4) comes to 19-20 units, but the catalog prints 'Total Units: 22-23'. That would be 16 plus 6-7, which suggests two courses may be required from the chosen group. A reviewer should check this.
CIS 120 and CIS 176 are not in the closed list and are recorded as catalog additions.
